model.name: Depth-Anything-V2-Small
model.semantics: relative depth; not meters; larger values represent nearer/foreground structure

input.preprocessing: Decode orientation-corrected RGB; resize aspect-preserving to fit 518x518; center-pad with normalized-zero (ImageNet-mean) pixels; divide RGB by 255; normalize mean [0.485,0.456,0.406] and std [0.229,0.224,0.225].

output.name: relative_depth
output.postprocessing: Remove the recorded centered padding, then bilinearly resize the numerical map to original evidence dimensions. Colorization is visualization only.

parity.sets: three square accident-review images and three portrait DATS images

rights.code_license: Project states Apache-2.0 for the Small model.
rights.checkpoint_status: Suitable for current local academic/development qualification; retain source attribution.
rights.training_data_status: Training-data provenance and terms remain separate from the checkpoint/code license and require compliance review.
rights.converted_artifact_status: Local development qualification only; public APK/model redistribution requires separate review.

limitations: Relative depth is not metric distance and does not establish forensic ground truth.
No arbitrary scale, vehicle distance, ground plane, camera pose, or 3D coordinates are provided.
TASK 007 boxes can later be sampled robustly, but boxes may contain background because TASK 008 masks are deferred.
Realme latency and memory have not been measured; those belong to TASK 009B.
